name: Conflict Resolution Framework
description: Synthesizes Thomas-Kilmann conflict modes, Nonviolent Communication (NVC), Crucial Conversations concepts, and Mediation principles into The Resolution Protocol - a systematic framework for navigating and resolving interpersonal conflict. Use when the user asks about conflict resolution framework, related techniques, best practices, or needs guidance in this domain. Do NOT use when the request is outside the scope of conflict resolution framework or requires a different specialized skill.
